copy.headline: Arlington teacher goes above and beyond to help students succeed after high school
copy.caption:
William Thorburn’s Fish for Life Foundation awards scholarships to help area students cover the cost of higher education. William “Bill” Thorburn, also known by his students as “Mr. T.,” takes special interest in helping hard-working students reach their educational goals.

52 Faces of Community is a Fort Worth Report weekly series spotlighting local unsung heroes. At the end of the year, these rarely recognized heroes will gather for a luncheon.

story.title: Arlington teacher goes above and beyond to help students succeed after high school
story.summary: William Thorburn’s Fish for Life Foundation awards scholarships to help area students cover the cost of higher education. William “Bill” Thorburn, also known by his students as “Mr. T.,” takes special interest in helping hard-working students reach their educational goals. 52 Faces of Community is a Fort Worth Report weekly series spotlighting local unsung heroes. It is sponsored by Central Market , H-E-B and JPS Health Network . At the end of the year, these rarely recognized heroes will gather for a luncheon. Fueled by this passion and armed with the knowledge that many students require assistance with post-high school educational expenses, Thorburn established the Fish for Life Foundation in 2007 and has served as its executive director ever since.
